description: Prospective v32 absent-target workshop experiment. Same absent scene, seed 5111 and 450 simulated seconds/$1.4 as v30. Adds eight architectural edge-midpoint candidates (four positions at existing low/high heights) to the eight corner candidates, in every room. They are not chosen from furniture/target truth; ordinary front/aux-depth endpoint and path evidence annotates every offered position. Jev selects every task, bypass and control. Includes v31 heading-progress fix, so improvement cannot be attributed solely to extra candidates. Evaluate distinct positions, inward surveys, front-depth spatial visibility, unreachable/repeated tasks, false reports, contacts and audit problems. Honest incomplete/timeout is not a successful find; never infer absence from visibility coverage.
